rules.name: temperature-degree-symbol
rules.description: Insert ° before a bare C/F following a number so NeMo expands it (72F -> 72°F -> 'seventy two degrees Fahrenheit').

rules.name: abbrev-with
rules.description: Expand the shorthand 'w/' into the spoken word 'with'.

rules.name: abbrev-without
rules.description: Expand the shorthand 'w/o' into the spoken words 'without'.
